summary: Kaniksu NF, Boundary County: 30 ft pole tower built 1935; staffed 1933-34 and 1946; abandoned in the 1950s; tower gone, frame cabin reported still there.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with L-6 cab, with a frame cabin
facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone; firelookout.com says the frame cabin is still there, undated

visit.trail_note: Hike-in site, per Idaho Fire Lookouts

events.note: Hollice Aldridge, listed for 1933-34, citing a Bonners Ferry Herald article of June 26, 1934; both years predate the 1935 tower

corrections.why: The FFLOS list gives 48.92019, and firelookout.com places the lookout 6 miles southeast of Eastport; the record's point is about 50 km south of the FFLOS point.
The FFLOS list gives -116.10939; the record's longitude is about 5 km west of that point.
Both sources say the lookout was abandoned in the 1950s; neither gives 1950 as a single year.

notes_for_editor: Chronology: staffing in 1933-34 (both pages) predates the 1935 tower; neither page explains this, so the 1935 build year may refer to a replacement or the staff dates may be loose. Cabin: firelookout.com says the frame cabin is still there but gives no date; the FFLOS list records only the tower as gone. The record's coordinates (48.46722, -116.1775) match neither the FFLOS list nor the firelookout.com description; the correction proposed above rests on those two. Hollice Aldridge's source, the Bonners Ferry Herald of June 26, 1934, and the Fire Lookouts of the Northwest book were cited by the pages but not read. Current access is not described in any source read.
